## Current Modules at UCD

I am currently lecturing the following undergraduate, graduate, and online modules in the School of Mathematics and Statistics at University College Dublin:

- **[STAT30280](https://sisweb.ucd.ie/usis/!W_HU_MENU.P_PUBLISH?p_tag=MODULE&MODULE=STAT30280)** — Inference for Data Analytics (2021–present)
- **[STAT30010](https://sisweb.ucd.ie/usis/!W_HU_MENU.P_PUBLISH?p_tag=MODULE&MODULE=STAT30010)** — Time Series Analysis
- **[STAT40700](https://sisweb.ucd.ie/usis/!W_HU_MENU.P_PUBLISH?p_tag=MODULE&MODULE=STAT40700)** — Time Series Analysis: Actuarial Applications
- **[STAT40860](https://sisweb.ucd.ie/usis/!W_HU_MENU.P_PUBLISH?p_tag=MODULE&MODULE=STAT40860)** — Time Series Analysis (Online)
